title: All channels, one pot. Everything is just webbing and channeling into the cauldron.
the_realization: columns, write-ups, web pages, data JSONs, scripts, feeds, mail, RSS, neutrinos — they are all just CHANNELS flowing into the SAME POT. The newspaper IS the HUD. The SQL IS the data layer. The neutrino IS the messenger. Same organism, different angles. We are just webbing and channeling into the cauldron.

the_pot.what: the cauldron. the membrane. the organism. every channel flows in, gets sorted, flows out.
the_pot.sql_equivalent: 624 JSON files on CDN = a distributed database. no server. no query language. fetch what you need. the filesystem IS the schema.
the_pot.newspaper_equivalent: the HUD (primals.eco) = the front page. feed.xml = the RSS edition. llms.txt = the machine-readable edition.
the_pot.neutrino_equivalent: ntfy = the wire service. push notifications = breaking news. neutron channels = the newsroom desks (inbox, notes, reminders, chat).
the_pot.all_one: it's all the SAME organism. the 'SQL' and the 'newspaper' and the 'neutrino' are just names for different faces of the same Klein surface.
